item.title: Meta hit with $25B penalty for deceiving users about privacy on Facebook
item.description:
📝 history, and a landmark victory holding Facebook accountable under state consumer protection law. item.title: EA is shutting down BioWare
item.description:
📝 Other major gaming companies have made sweeping changes this year as well, including Xbox’s “reset” that will include 3,200 cuts, Bungie’s “significant” layoffs, and Fortnite maker Epic Games laying off over 1,000 staff. Here is the full message that BioWare shared on social media:For more than 30 years, BioWare has been more than a studio. Now, after more than three decades of shared adventures, BioWare is closing and early development on the next Mass Effect project is ending.
🔗 Read more: https://www.theverge.com/games/1015647/ea-is-shutting-down-bioware
